newsitem.title: USA: Oregon sells $40 mln of college bonds - treasurer.
newsitem.headline: Oregon sells $40 mln of college bonds - treasurer.

text.p: Oregon Treasurer Jim Hill said Thursday the state would issue $40 million of so-called Baccalaureate bonds to fund projects at five state universities.
Hill said proceeds from the bond sale would fund student family housing as well as library renovations.
Hill said the order period for the bonds began Thursday. The state Treasury plans to sell a limited number of bonds valued at $1,000. Typically all of the bonds are valued at $5,000, Hill said.
Since 1988, the state Treasury has issued about $220 million of the bonds.
